hni_signals: Carries an institutional leadership title on top of clinical practice - Clinical Director at Yashoda Hospitals Hitec City, alongside Senior Consultant Gastroenterologist, Hepatologist & Advanced Therapeutic Endoscopist. International society footprint unusual for a private-practice Indian clinician: member of EASL (European Association for the Study of the Liver) and the World Hepatitis Alliance, plus the Indian Society of Gastroenterology and the Society for GI Endoscopy; registered with the Telangana State Medical Council. Credentials MBBS (Andhra Medical College, Visakhapatnam, 2002), MD General Medicine (Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences, 2007), DM Gastroenterology (Sri Ramachandra University, Chennai, 2012). Career progression through a peer corporate group: previously Consultant Gastroenterologist, Hepatologist & Advanced Therapeutic Endoscopist at Apollo Hospital, Jubilee Hills. Listed on the Government of India Advantage Healthcare (healinindia.gov.in) directory, which hospitals use to market consultants to inbound medical-value-travel patients. Runs his own personal professional website and maintains his own brand presence across LinkedIn, a professional Facebook page, a Medtalks HCP profile and Doctube; the hospital also fronts him in official DoctorTalk and Health Talk education segments - all signals of a hospital's marquee, revenue-generating specialist.

notes: Verified across TWO independent OFFICIAL sources on different domains: (1) yashodahospitals.com - his doctor profile whose URL encodes branch and department in the path (/doctor/hitech-city/gastroenterology/dr-k-s-somasekhar-rao/), plus official DoctorTalk, Health Talk and gastro-team pages; (2) healinindia.gov.in - the Government of India Advantage Healthcare doctor directory, a .gov.in domain. They agree on name, specialty (medical gastroenterology / hepatology) and city, and the input row's title is reproduced almost verbatim on the Yashoda page ('Senior Consultant Gastroenterologist, Hepatologist & Advanced Therapeutic Endoscopist' plus 'Clinical Director'), matching name + specialty + hospital + branch (Hitec City) + city + experience (19 vs 21 years). AFFILIATION CAVEAT on the government listing: healinindia.gov.in files him under Apollo Hospitals Hyderabad, which is his PRIOR post - a separate listing states the identical three-part title against Apollo Hospital Jubilee Hills. So the .gov.in page corroborates the person and the specialty, not the current hospital; the current Yashoda Hitec City affiliation rests on Yashoda's own domain. Treated as a stale entry on the government side, not as a second person: the three-part title, the sub-specialty mix and the city all match. CONTACT REJECTED - this is the trap the brief warns about. A search summary offered 'telehealth@yashodamail.com' and '917207572075' as contact details for him. Both are Yashoda Hospitals' CENTRAL telehealth email and helpline, not his own line, so recording either as professional_email / professional_phone would be passing a hospital booking line off as the doctor's. Discarded; professional_email and professional_phone are left blank, and no hospital-level value was smuggled into them (the pipeline supplies hospital fallbacks anyway). HUMAN CHECK: personal_website http://drkssomasekharrao.com/ appeared verbatim as an organic result titled 'Dr. K S Somasekhar Rao', so it is recorded rather than constructed; however a follow-up exact-string query on that domain surfaced his Medtalks profile (whose handle is the same slug) rather than the site itself, so someone should confirm the site is live and is genuinely his before using it. LinkedIn is his own personal profile (titled 'K S Soma Sekhar Rao - Yashoda Hospitals'), not a company page. Facebook page /doctorsekhar/ is recorded as professional use - it is a named doctor page in Hyderabad, but a human may want to confirm it is a practice page rather than a private account. owns_clinic left false: a personal website is branding, not evidence of an independent clinic, and no clinic entity was found.
